primary_endpoint.metric: patient-level mean Spearman map correlation across 20 frozen repeats

randomization_test.null: patient-level exchangeability under independent sign flips
randomization_test.prespecified_target: two-sided sign-flip randomization test on mean paired delta
randomization_test.operational_method: fixed-seed Monte Carlo approximation to the same sign-flip randomization distribution

relation_permutation_rng.subject_ordinal: 1-based lexicographic order of the frozen 74-subject cohort
relation_permutation_rng.query_index: 0-based position in the frozen query_sites list

sensitivity_only: exact two-sided binomial sign test on nonzero patient deltas
